back_cover.headline: The warming is certain. How we live through it is not.
paragraphs: The world has already warmed by about 1.4 °C, 2024 was the hottest year ever measured, and the carbon budget for 1.5 °C is almost spent. Heat waves, floods, droughts, disease and displacement are no longer forecasts — they are the conditions of daily life for hundreds of millions of people.

*Surviving the Future* is a clear, evidence-based guide to the century ahead. Drawing on the IPCC, the World Meteorological Organization, the Lancet Countdown and research from Indonesia and Southeast Asia, it explains what is happening, what is coming, and — above all — what individuals, families and communities can do to stay safe, healthy and secure.
